description: On a 1280x800 screen, the base modal dismisses when the backdrop is clicked beside the panel at the panel's mid-height. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 2. Press Control+k, wait for ".command-palette-input" to be visible, fill it with "feature" and click the first ".command-palette-item". 3. Wait for the panel (".modal") to be visible. 4. Click the viewport point x = (panel left) / 2, y = panel top + panel height / 2, computed from the panel's bounding box as the click runs: in the empty gap left of the panel, at its vertical middle. 5. ".modal" count should become 0.

steps.point: (() => { const r = document.querySelector(".modal").getBoundingClientRect(); return {x: r.left / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2}; })()
